name: TV and IPTV
description: IPTV (M3U) playlists with channels, groups and favourites: watch a channel on Atena's screens, on a Windows PC in a widget window, on Chromecast or DLNA TVs, by voice or with automatic rules.
capabilities: M3U playlists from an address or a file, encrypted on disk because they contain the provider's credentials
Viewing on Atena's screens, in a window on the Windows PC, on Chromecast and DLNA TVs
By voice: «put on Rai 1», «show Rai 1 on the pc», «watch Rai 3 on the living room Chromecast»
Rules: at a time, on waking up or when a person arrives, a channel on a device
Secure relay: signed, expiring links, no open proxy
